items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: he put me in his orchestra there... I used to work and reference with him, in his band

ctx.x: Did you get into that band then soon?

Well, and, uh, no, I didn't get into the brass band because they had an orchestra there then, was a fellow named Wilbur Winstead, Wilbur Winstead had an orchestra. While then he, uh, he'd taken an interest in me and he put me in his orchestra there, and that way I began to, those different fellas helped me along that way, this is the way I began to learn how to play the trumpet. And then I, uh, he carried me from there, I used to work and reference with him, in his band, and he played in the brass band over in…
Did these boys and fellas all help you to learn music, to read music right away, or did you play by ear at first?
